islands: complete port search intersecting exactly one landmass and one island; at least one earlier butterfly species and one recorded alien candidate host
pairs: all distinct unordered eligible island pairs; empty new-butterfly union is undefined, not similarity zero
plant_metric: Jaccard similarity of distinct alien candidate host plants, unanimous regional classification across completed ports on island
butterfly_metric: Jaccard similarity of species first recorded on each island in 2011-2022; no claim of colonization
comparisons: Spearman association; descriptive partial rank association controlling log1p great-circle distance between mean port coordinates and earlier butterfly Jaccard; equal island endpoint weighting sensitivity
inference: No ordinary pair-independent p-values or confidence intervals. New-window species may have been historically present but unrecorded. Plant 2001-2024 data are retrospective; no prediction claim. Port distance is not route or maritime connectivity. No added radius-band acquisition.
